_what: Looks and levels for the edit-map line (edit_map.py → render_map.py). SETTINGS, brand-agnostic: an ad picks a look by id in its decisions.json (`text_looks`, `option_cards.look_id`, `captions.look_id`); nothing about one brand, product or swipe lives in the code. Colours are RGBA 0-255; y is the share of the frame height from the top; sizes are pixels on a 1080x1920 frame.

headline-plain._what: white bold words, dark outline, no box — the neutral default for an opening headline

headline-pink-box._what: white caps on a pink box with a cyan edge (the an-earlier-run swipe's headline)

swipe-card._what: the an-earlier-run creator's own cover card, matched off the cover (4 Oct 2026, the owner: 'you're missing the white in the text itself'): a hot-pink rounded box behind EACH line, blue caps with a white outline in a comic marker face. Ugly on purpose: it's what the creator did, and what stopped people

thumb-bold._what: the thumbnail's words: big white type on a dark band in the middle-lower safe zone, clear of the face and the feed bars

native-pop._what: a short bold word on a dark rounded box — a natively edited text pop (the owner, 3 Oct: 'option 1, option 2 … natively edited')

ig-fb-native._what: Instagram / Facebook native: sentence case, white on a soft dark box, above the feed buttons (the owner, 3 Oct)

fonts._what: first file that exists wins; a looks/fonts file can be put first once installed
